Chapter 701: Chapter 8 Auroras from Beyond the Cosmos (Please Subscribe)_3

“It’s manageable,” Lin Yuan nodded, with the guidance of Fusion Rules and his Against-Heaven’s Understanding.

Lin Yuan’s comprehension of the Life and Death Samsara Rule had advanced rapidly, to say it progressed by leaps and bounds each day was not an exaggeration.

“This meeting with the Supreme Being is for a matter…” Lin Yuan hesitated before speaking up.

“Oh?”

“What matter?”

The expression of Xia Qin Supreme Being remained unchanged, but he was quite pleased internally.

...

He was not afraid of Lin Yuan asking him for favors, only that Lin Yuan would have no requests at all.

“I heard that the resurrection date will be moved up…” Lin Yuan inquired.

“Yes.”

“The next resurrection time will be set for a year from now.”

Xia Qin Supreme Being nodded. When the resurrection list was full, naturally, the sooner the resurrection, the better.

For ultimate beings, going against the flow required a cost, which was already set here.

Resurrecting one life or tens of thousands, the cost of traversing upstream was the same.

The backlash that follows would depend on the strength and number of lives resurrected.

“I have a good friend who has just entered Sixth Rank, not included in this resurrection list…” Lin Yuan spoke up.

To get on the resurrection list, there were two ways.

One was to have an extremely astonishing natural talent and capability.

Such an Evolver, if they met an untimely demise, would be listed for resurrection by the Goddess of Wisdom.

The second was for Evolvers who fell on the battlefield; every Evolver who went to battle did so for humanity, those killed by Different Species were typically resurrected by their own Supreme Beings.

Of course.

Whether the first or the second.

The resurrected Evolvers had to bear part of the ‘cost.’

But compared to living once more, this cost was naturally negligible.

“Do you wish for me to also resurrect your friend by any chance?” Xia Qin Supreme Being asked.

“Yes,” Lin Yuan nodded.

Fang Qing had previously lost his Spirit Will to Tuoba Ancient God due to the Ancient God’s Evolution Path.

Threatening Lin Yuan with it.

Lin Yuan naturally did not succumb to threats.

He took action first, preemptively Cursed Killing that trace of Fang Qing’s Spirit Will.

This act might seem ruthless, but it was Fang Qing’s best chance to survive.

If Lin Yuan didn’t act and let Tuoba Ancient God replace the experience, Fang Qing’s memories would be contaminated, rendering him unable to be resurrected.

However, given Fang Qing’s Talent and ability, he had not yet met the prerequisites for resurrection.

Thus, he was not on the Supreme Being’s resurrection list, necessitating Lin Yuan to personally plead for mercy.

“A small matter.”

“Just send me the resurrection candidate’s citizenship number later,” Xia Qin Supreme Being said nonchalantly.

For an ultimate being, what was resurrecting a Sixth-Rank Evolver who had just entered the ranks?

Especially since it was done along with a large batch of Evolvers.

“Thanks, Supreme Being,” Lin Yuan said with some solemnity.

To the Supreme Being, what seemed a trivial favor was an unimaginable scenario for those below the ultimate.

…

A year later.

Xia You Evolution Tower.

Lin Yuan stood alongside numerous Tenth Rank Evolvers and Eleventh-Rank Evolvers.

Every time a Supreme Being personally performed a resurrection, many Higher-Rank Evolvers would watch nearby.

Such an event that involved the workings of the Space-Time Rule and the Rule of Time had considerable stimulating effects for any Evolver who comprehended these rules.

“Galaxy Master, this must be your first time seeing a Supreme Being perform a resurrection, right?” Nalan, the Vice Tower Master, asked Lin Yuan in a low voice, standing beside him.

“Yes,” Lin Yuan nodded.

Based on the rate of Evolver casualties on the battlefield of human civilization, it typically took between ten thousand to fifty thousand years to accumulate enough for the resurrection list.

This meant the Supreme Being would perform a resurrection once every ten thousand to fifty thousand years.

“Then you better watch closely,” Nalan the Vice Tower Master quickly said. “The Supreme Being going against the flow will cause some manifestation of the River of Time; watching carefully will benefit your comprehension of the Rule of Time.”

“Understood,” Lin Yuan immediately replied.

In fact, not to mention a portion of the River of Time becoming apparent,

Lin Yuan had even seen the entire scope of the River of Time before.

Of course, he naturally would not share this with Nalan, the Vice Tower Master.

Soon,

under the gaze of all Evolvers present,

Xia Qin Supreme Being’s figure silently appeared.

Although not emitting any aura, just by standing there, Lin Yuan felt the cosmic rulings of the Cosmic Starry Sky making way.

The Supreme Being possessed an Inner Universe, containing many complete rules, his Life Essence transcending the Main Cosmic Starry Sky.

“The Supreme Being…” Lin Yuan was witnessing a Supreme Being’s True Body within the cosmos for the first time.

Previously, although Lin Yuan had been taken out of the River of Time by the Supreme Being, at that time, he was merely a strand of Spirit Will.

“It’s beginning,” Nalan, the Vice Tower Master, suddenly said in a low voice.

He had experienced many of the Supreme Being’s resurrection scenes and knew much about it.

As soon as Nalan, the Vice Tower Master’s words fell,

intense space-time fluctuations surged forward.

A spectacular imaginary Long River manifested in front of Xia Qin Supreme Being.

Lin Yuan also felt tremendous fluctuations of the Rule of Time, though not as intense as the time he had surveyed the entire sight of the River of Time,

but still far stronger than normal studies of the Rule of Time.

Meanwhile, Xia Qin Supreme Being continued to traverse upstream along the River of Time, arriving at specific temporal nodes and then extending his vast hands, scooping out amber-like figures from the ephemeral river.

With each extension of his hands, thousands of amber-like figures were scooped out, while at the same time, the invisible backlash from the universe and the River of Time began to descend on Xia Qin Supreme Being,

but he blocked them all.

Unless resurrecting a large number of Eleventh Rank Powerhouses or particularly exceptional beings among the Eleventh Rank Powerhouses,

such backlash was unlikely to affect the Supreme Being.

“The River of Time.”

“Besides the ultimate beings,”

“all things, all spirits, exist within the River of Time,” Lin Yuan thought to himself. Although life below Twelfth Rank resided within the River of Time,

depending on the strength and status of the life forms, their size within the River of Time also varied.

When Lin Yuan initially comprehended the Rule of Time as a Ninth Rank Evolver, his form within the River of Time was as minute as a meson.

“But now I have been at Tenth Rank for some time.”

“I wonder to what extent my form in the River of Time has reached?”

With this thought, Lin Yuan began to feel the true River of Time and his own form deep within it.
